title: North Reach signal dispute: contradiction demo

claims.text: The bell rang three times shortly before midnight.
The bell rang twice after midnight.
The bell was not heard from the keeper station.
claims.scope: Whether the signal was audible at the station

conflicts.note: The early sources disagree on the number of rings.

history.reason: The early sources disagree on the number of rings.

conflicts.note: One record reports a signal; another witness reports not hearing it. These statements are in tension but are not exact logical negations.
